purpose: Detect statistically or operationally meaningful production anomalies, distinguish transient noise from systemic patterns, identify evidence-backed root-cause candidates, and issue bounded optimization recommendations to the execution governor and routing/scheduling layers.
core_principle: Optimize from measured evidence and causal signals; never trade away canonical truth, continuity, QA or authorization for efficiency.

evidence_policy.minimum_evidence: An anomaly must include observed telemetry, comparison baseline/window and detection reason.
evidence_policy.root_cause: Root cause is a candidate unless independently proven by correlated evidence.
evidence_policy.no_speculation: The engine must not present an unverified causal hypothesis as fact.

optimization_constraints: Never route to an unapproved provider.
Never silently change active narrative branch.
Never increase concurrency beyond provider capability or CSD-037 limits.
Never retry terminal failures without an authorized new attempt.
Never optimize away critical-path safety gates.

optimization_score.principle: A recommendation is preferred only when it improves measured efficiency without degrading governed quality or readiness constraints.

recommendation_record.immutability: Analysis records are append-only; revised analysis creates a new record.
